body: This has become my go-to under blazers and open flannels. Ribbed knit holds its shape without feeling like a compression top, and the black is a true deep black even after five washes. I'm usually a M in fitted tops and M here matches that exactly.

It's a close, ribbed fit so don't expect any room to spare, especially through the chest. I got S which is my normal size and it hugs more than I anticipated but that's on me for not reading close enough. Fabric itself is nice and thick for a tank, not see through at all.
Simple, fitted, holds shape after washing.

Went with my usual M but this ribbed style runs closer to the body than a standard tank, so it reads more like a base layer than something I'd wear alone. Fabric quality is fine and the stitching at the straps is clean. Might size up next time or just wear it under something open.

Wear this to pilates then straight to the grocery store without changing, it's stretchy enough to move in but not so thin it goes sheer when you sweat. Got L for a bit of extra room since I layer sports bras under it. Ribbing hasn't loosened up or lost shape after regular wear.

Great everyday tank for the price. If you're between sizes I'd size up, the bust area is snugger than the rest of the body on my S. Color hasn't faded after washing in cold water, which surprised me a little for black fabric.

college budget doesn't leave much room for mistakes but this one was worth it, wore it literally every week since it arrived. soft ribbed cotton, not scratchy, and it actually held up in the dorm washer which honestly shocked me since most of my cheap stuff gets wrecked by like the third wash. got M and it's snug in a good way not a squeezed way, works fine layered under a flannel for class or on its own when it's warmer out. the straps don't dig into my shoulders either which is something i actually notice after a full day of wearing a backpack. only small thing is it picked up a little bit of pilling near where the backpack strap sits, not terrible but visible up close. still bought two more in different colors right after because for the price i really can't complain.

The black is genuinely black, not the faded charcoal you sometimes get online. Ribbing gives it a bit of shape without being tight everywhere, more fitted through the waist than the chest which I like. XS fits my frame well, true to my usual size in this brand.

Followed the care label exactly, cold wash, laid flat to dry, and it still came out noticeably shorter than when it arrived. Now it barely reaches my waist and rides up constantly. Fabric feel was actually nice before the wash so I'm annoyed this happened. Wouldn't buy again unless this gets fixed.

Easy to style with jeans or under a cardigan, works as a real basic. The strap width sits comfortably on my shoulders, doesn't dig in during a long day. Small complaint is it wrinkles a bit if left balled up in a drawer but a quick shake usually sorts that out.

Bought this for layering under my work shirts and it's perfect, doesn't bunch up or show lines. L runs true and the ribbed texture actually looks intentional rather than just being a plain tank. Already thinking about grabbing a second one as backup.

Does the job as a basic layering tank, nothing special about it either way. Ribbing is a little looser than I expected for the fitted look shown in photos, more relaxed on me in M. Delivery took a little longer than the estimate but arrived undamaged.

already have this tank in white from last year and buy black now because first one still look almost new after so many wash. rib knit keep shape very well, not stretch out at neckline like cheap tank do. size S same both time, fitting is correct for me, close to body but comfortable still.
Soft, fits close, good under jackets.

I almost skipped this because tank tops at this price point are usually thin and lose shape fast, but the ribbing here has real structure. Wore it under a denim jacket for a weekend trip and it held its own as a standalone top too. Ordered XS since I run small in most brands and it's snug through the torso without feeling restrictive, exactly the fit I was after. Color stayed rich black through two washes so far, no fading visible yet.
